question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the Council of Ministers at the Union level?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 74**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 74** of the Indian Constitution provides for a **Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister** to aid and advise the President of India.
 
• The President is bound to act according to the advice provided by the Council of Ministers. **This ensures a parliamentary form of government.**
 
• The Council of Ministers includes the **Prime Minister, Cabinet Ministers, Ministers of State, and Deputy Ministers**.
 
• The provision under Article 74 emphasizes the principle of collective responsibility, ensuring that the Council of Ministers functions as a unified body to support governance.
